summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature without running any tests or repo code, and without committing. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in ControlCode. rich/control.py adds the format entry emitting ESC ] 0 ; title BEL and the Control.title classmethod with a docstring. rich/console.py adds set_window_title beside show_cursor, checking only is_terminal, buffering via self.control, and returning True/False. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one elif branch calling term.set_title(title). CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200. Tests added to tests/test_control.py, tests/test_console.py (forced terminal, skipped on win32), and tests/test_windows_renderer.py (mocked set_title). Test results: not run, per instructions; the code was verified by reading only.
